[P2] Revisit the scanner policy under Rules 2 and 7

Rule 2 requires the description to identify simpler alternatives and explain why they do not work whenever logic is added; the description only presents the chosen scanner expansion. Rule 7 also requires explicit decisions and reasons, but this applies the OpenSearch-motivated whitespace restriction to every engine without documenting that compatibility decision. For example, a PostgreSQL read ending in `--comment` now throws. Return to the design phase under Rule 8, evaluate simplifications, and document the intended cross-engine rejection policy and its compatibility costs before continuing.
